title: Bridge config
description: Where a design system repository keeps its DTCG tokens and which brands, themes and densities it has. Read by @bridge-ds/core, the DS Bridge Figma plugin, the CLI and the MCP server.

defaultBranch.description: Branch that pulls read from and pull requests target.

tokens.description: Token locations. root is relative to the repository root; every other path is relative to root.

brands.description: Brand tier: <brand>.tokens.json (palette, radius and font roles), plus optional <brand>.<theme>.tokens.json semantic overrides.

semantic.description: Semantic tier: <theme>.tokens.json, plus the theme-independent base file.

base.description: Stem of the theme-independent semantic file in the semantic directory.

dir.description: Code components directory, relative to the repository root.

package.description: Package a changeset bumps when tokens change. Without it, no changeset is written.

previews.description: Branch previews: packages published as snapshots per PR commit, and per-branch deploy URL templates. See docs/PREVIEWS.md.

packages.description: Packages published to pkg.pr.new (or as release tarballs) for every PR commit.

docs.description: Docs site preview. URL template. Placeholders: {branch} (Vercel-style slug), {rawBranch}, {pr}, {sha}, {sha7}.

storybook.description: Storybook preview. URL template. Placeholders: {branch} (Vercel-style slug), {rawBranch}, {pr}, {sha}, {sha7}.

admin.description: Admin demo preview. URL template. Placeholders: {branch} (Vercel-style slug), {rawBranch}, {pr}, {sha}, {sha7}.
